questions.q: Why did Dab-Dab tell the Doctor to ask the eagles for help?
choices: Eagles fly faster than any other bird in the whole sky
Eagles know every sailor on the seven seas
No living creature can see better than an eagle
Eagles are the only birds that fly at night
questions.evidence: No living creature can see better than an eagle

questions.q: How many different kinds of eagles came to the ship?
choices: Two
Six
Ten
Nine

questions.q: Why did Gub-Gub hide behind a barrel when the eagles came?
choices: He was scared of their terrible eyes
He wanted to play a hiding game
He was cold and the barrel was warm
He was eating lunch and did not want to share
questions.evidence: Gub-Gub was scared of them and got behind a barrel

questions.q: What did the eagles find in the main street of Gibraltar?
choices: A red handkerchief lying in front of a baker's door
An anchor painted on the side of a fishing-boat
A gold ring dropped in a horses' drinking-trough
Three red hairs from a fur-coat on a wheel-barrow
questions.evidence: three red hairs lying on a wheel-barrow before a baker's door

questions.q: Jip says the eagles are "just conceited." What does "conceited" mean?
choices: Very tired after a long trip
Afraid of being laughed at
Thinking too highly of yourself
Kind and helpful to others

questions.q: What was Jip's complaint about the porpoises?
choices: They swam off toward Brazil without even saying good-by
They only told where the man ISN'T, not where he IS
They told the boy that his uncle had been drowned
They were too busy gossiping to look for the man
questions.evidence: We don't want to know where he ISN'T--we want to know where he IS

questions.q: What made Jip decide to start searching for the uncle himself?
choices: Gub-Gub said Jip couldn't do as well as the eagles
The Doctor ordered him to go and find the man
The boy begged Jip to help him find his uncle
Dab-Dab said that dogs were no good at finding anybody at all

questions.q: Why did Jip say the gold ring was no good?
choices: It belonged to the boy, not the uncle
It had been washed in the salty sea
It was too small for him to sniff
He smelled it and it gave him no help

questions.q: What smell did Jip find on the uncle's red handkerchief?
choices: Tar and fish-oil
Burnt pipe-tobacco
Black Rappee snuff
Wet sea-weed and salt

questions.q: Why did Jip say he didn't need any light to look for the uncle?
choices: He could see better in the dark than an owl
He would follow the man by smell, not by sight
The moon would be bright enough for him that night
The swallows would show him the way in the dark
questions.evidence: I don't need any light to look for a man who smells of Black Rappee snuff

questions.q: According to Jip, what kind of wind is best for long-distance smelling?
choices: A nice, steady, damp breeze
A fierce, cold wind from the North
A hot, dry wind from the desert
A gusty wind that changes often
questions.evidence: A nice, steady, damp breeze is the best of all

questions.q: After sniffing the North wind, what did Jip say they must do?
choices: Sail North toward Devon and Wales at once
Ask the eagles to go and search once more
Go back to the island of the canaries
Wait till the wind changes to the South
questions.evidence: We must wait till the wind changes to the South

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The eagles find the uncle on an island far away
Gub-Gub learns that he can smell things just as well as Jip
Jip shows how his sharp nose may find the lost uncle
The Doctor writes a new book about the eagles
questions.evidence: The man's as good as found
